fullPassage: Imagine you take your bicycle to a repair shop. You expect the workers at the shop to do what you paid them to do, which is to fix your bicycle. If they do a good job, you will be back again next time for bike repairs. If they do a bad job, however, you will look for a new repair shop. The same is true with governments. It is our job as citizens to make sure that government does what is expected. If they do a good job, we can trust them in the future. If they don't, we can explain why we won't vote for them again. This kind of participation in government is important. How much effort we put into participating depends on how well we think the government is doing. If we are satisfied, we will do very little besides voting. But if we are dissatisfied, we will probably take other types of action.

questions.passage: If we are __________ (satisfy), we will do very little besides voting.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: satisfy(만족시키다) → satisfied(만족한). be동사 뒤 형용사/과거분사 형태
det.analysis: satisfy를 satisfied로 변환. 'If we are satisfied'(우리가 만족하면) — be동사(are) 뒤에는 형용사 역할을 하는 과거분사 satisfied가 필요
det.tip: we are _____ → be동사 뒤 감정 형용사 → satisfied

questions.passage: How much effort we put into __________ (participate) depends on how well we think the government is doing.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: participate(참여하다) → participating(동명사). 전치사 into 뒤에는 동명사(-ing)
det.analysis: participate를 participating으로 변환. 'put into participating'(참여에 쏟다) — 전치사 into 뒤에는 명사 역할을 하는 동명사(-ing)가 와야 함
det.tip: 전치사(into) 뒤 → 동명사(-ing) → participating

questions.passage: Imagine you take your bicycle to a repair shop. You expect the workers at the shop to do what you paid them to do, which is to fix your bicycle. If they do a good job, you will be back again next time for bike repairs. If they do a bad job, however, you will look for a new repair shop. The same is true with governments. It is our job as citizens to make sure that government does what is expected. If they do a good job, we can trust them in the future. If they don't, we can explain why we won't vote for them again. This kind of participation in government is important. How much effort we put into participating depends on how well we think the government is doing. If we are satisfied, we will do very little besides voting. But if we are dissatisfied, we will probably take __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: a break from voting=투표 중단 / a good job again=다시 좋은 일 / control of the shop=가게 통제 / other types of action=다른 종류의 행동
det.analysis:
① a break from voting: 불만족한데 투표를 쉰다? 문맥 부적절
② a good job again: 우리가 좋은 일을? 주체가 안 맞음
③ control of the shop: 가게 통제? 정부 문맥과 무관
④ other types of action: 불만족하면 (투표 외의) 다른 종류의 행동을 취할 것이다 ←정답
det.tip: dissatisfied(불만족) → probably take __________ → 다른 행동(other types of action)

questions.passage: Imagine you take your bicycle to a repair shop. You expect the workers at the shop to do what you paid them to do, which is to fix your bicycle. If they do a good job, you will be back again next time for bike repairs. If they do a bad job, however, you will look for a new repair shop. The same is true with governments. It is our job as citizens to make sure that government does what is expected. If they do a good job, we can trust them in the future. If they don't, we can explain why we won't vote for them again. This kind of participation in government is important. How much effort we put into participating depends on __________. If we are satisfied, we will do very little besides voting. But if we are dissatisfied, we will probably take other types of action.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: how well we think the government is doing=정부가 얼마나 잘하고 있다고 생각하는지 / how much money we have=돈이 얼마나 있는지 / who we vote for next time=다음에 누구를 뽑을지 / when the next election happens=다음 선거가 언제인지
det.analysis:
① how well we think the government is doing: 참여에 쏟는 노력은 정부를 얼마나 잘한다고 보는지에 달려 있다 ←정답
② how much money we have: 돈의 많고 적음? 문맥 무관
③ who we vote for next time: 다음 투표 대상? depends on의 근거로 부적절
④ when the next election happens: 선거 시기? 무관
det.tip: effort depends on __________ → 정부 평가(how well the government is doing)
